title: Roadmap Conductor: team orchestration playbook for dependency cutovers
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: Cross-team cutovers (e.g., model swap, KV cache migration, console route change) currently depend on informal signals and ad-hoc checklists. This leads to last-minute rollbacks, unclear ownership during handoffs, and duplicate work from design/infra/security that blocks go/no-go decisions.

Goal: Create a repeatable, lightweight orchestration playbook — the 'Roadmap Conductor' — that standardizes preflight checks, ownership handoff, escalation steps, and OKR-aligned signoffs for any dependency-driven roadmap cutover across Eng/Design/Security/Infra. The playbook should be suitable for both Hosted API and Dedicated/Private deployment cutovers.

Scope: 
- Standard preflight checklist templates (latency, error budgets, feature flags, runbook links).
- Ownership matrix and single-point-of-contact per domain for the cutover window.
- Automated signalboard integration (Console dashboards + Slack alert channels) that surfaces readiness: capacity, security review, design QA, e2e pass rate.
- Cutover choreography steps with timeboxed windows, rollback criteria, and post-cutover validation.
- OKR linkage: map cutover tasks to initiative-level OKRs and provide a one-line readiness status for executive reporting.

Out of scope: Full CI automation of cutovers and infra provisioning (refer to ENG-5721 and INF-2280).

acceptance_criteria: A1: Confluence playbook published with templates for preflight, cutover choreography, rollback criteria, and post-cutover validation.
A2: Signalboard prototype integrated with Console dashboards showing three readiness signals (capacity, security signoff, design QA) and a combined readiness badge.
A3: Ownership matrix template that enforces a single SRE/Eng owner, a Design reviewer, and a Security approver for each cutover. Template is used on two pilot cutovers.
A4: Two pilot cutovers executed (one Hosted API model swap, one Dedicated capacity resize) with documentable learnings and <1 hour total customer-facing degradation across both pilots.
A5: OKR mapping added to initiative in Roadmap board and a short executive readiness one-liner available in the weekly report.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (alpha): internal pilot with Eng runtime and Console teams (Mar 2026). Phase 2 (beta): include Design and Security on two customer-impact cutovers (Apr 2026). Phase 3: organization-wide adoption and templates baked into Linear issue creation (May 2026). Continuous improvement via postmortem learnings and quarterly updates.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Teams treat playbook as 'checkbox' and skip thorough validations. Mitigation: require explicit evidence links (dashboard screenshots, PRs, test run IDs) for signoffs.
Risk: Signalboard false positives/negatives. Mitigation: start with conservative thresholds and a human-in-loop confirmation step for first 2 months.
Risk: Extra overhead for small cutovers. Mitigation: provide a 'lightweight' checklist variant and auto-fill fields from existing dashboards/PR metadata.
Risk: Cross-team scheduling conflicts. Mitigation: include an availability matrix in the playbook and a default escalation rota.
